{{Quote|On Cholganna, the dinner bell is always ringing somewhere.|Joma Dehn|<ref name="Rim" />}}
'''Cholganna''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] best known for its cool [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and dangerous creatures. It was home to the [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], a predatory [[Feline/Legends|feline]]. Animals such as the [[Arboreal octopus/Legends|arboreal octopus]] and the [[Bark rat/Legends|bark rat]] were also plentiful on the planet. Both were known prey of the nexu.
